author: Z.ai (official blog)
text: Open Source: We will release the weights in two weeks after launch, once safety evaluation and hardening are complete.
notes: Pre-release signal for the open-weights event only (model itself launched same day). Fulfilled: HF zai-org/GLM-5.3 "Initial commit 0828", public 2026-08-28 (exactly two weeks).

author: Z.ai (official blog)
text: Before release, we tested GLM-5.3-Flash anonymously as ox-alpha on OpenCode and OpenRouter to gather user feedback.
notes: Anonymous public test before the 2026-08-26 launch; disclosed only in the launch blog (2026-08-26). Dates of the anonymous test not stated officially.

author: Z.ai (official blog and HF model card)
text: GLM-5.1 will be available on Z.ai in the coming days.
notes: Concerns consumer-app availability after the API/open-weights launch. Same sentence on https://huggingface.co/zai-org/GLM-5.1. Actual chat.z.ai date not found.

author: Z.ai (official blog)
text: We are now scaling this recipe to larger models — GLM-5.3-Flash pushes the cost-performance frontier, and the lessons from building it are already shaping our next frontier model.
notes: No newer frontier GLM model found as of 2026-11-20 (latest docs.z.ai release-notes entry is 2026-08-26).

author: Moonshot AI / Kimi (official tech blog)
text: The full model weights will be released by July 27, 2026.
notes: Pre-release signal for the open-weights event (model launched on product/API the same day). Fulfilled: HF moonshotai/Kimi-K3 initial commit 2026-07-27T13:31Z, public 2026-07-27.

author: Moonshot AI / Kimi (official tech blog)
text: Full model weights will be released by Nov 4, 2026.
notes: Pre-release signal for the open-weights event. Fulfilled: HF moonshotai/Kimi-K3.1-Pro repo created 2026-11-02, first public activity 2026-11-04.

author: Moonshot AI / Kimi (official tech blog, API docs, HF card)
text: We're introducing Kimi K3.1 Pro, the first model in our new K3.1 series
notes: Implies more K3.1-series models; none released as of 2026-11-20. Same wording in https://www.kimi.com/blog/kimi-k3-1-pro and the HF model card.

author: MoonshotAI/kimi-cli (official GitHub changelog, v1.37.0)
text: Show the provider-supplied display_name (e.g. k2.6-code-preview) for managed models
notes: Confirms a "K2.6 Code Preview" served to Kimi Code users; changelog entry is dated the same day as K2.6 GA, so it does not prove an earlier start. Third-party reports say a closed beta ran from about 2026-04-13 (kimi-cli v1.33.0 on 2026-04-13 also dropped hard-coded kimi-k2.5 references), unverified officially.

author: Moonshot AI / Kimi (official tech blog)
text: In beta tests, K2.6 performs well on long-horizon coding tasks in enterprise evaluations
notes: Disclosed in the 2026-04-20 launch blog; confirms pre-release enterprise beta testing, dates not stated.
